scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays product name, tagline, and call-to-action buttons correctly (REQ-1)

steps.description: Open the MirDB landing page in a web browser
steps.context: User arrives at the landing page from search engine, GitHub, or referral

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains product name (MirDB), tagline, and CTA buttons
steps.context: Hero section should be prominently displayed above the fold

steps.description: Click on primary and secondary CTA buttons and verify they navigate to correct destinations
steps.context: Buttons should link to GitHub repository or documentation

test_cases.input: Load landing page and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is displayed prominently with large, clear typography
Tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' or similar is displayed
Primary CTA button (e.g., 'Get Started' or 'View on GitHub') is visible and clickable
Secondary action button (e.g., 'Learn More' or 'Documentation') is present
Button navigates to GitHub repository or getting started section

scenarios.name: Key Value Propositions Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the three main value propositions are clearly presented (REQ-2)

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the features/value proposition section of the landing page
steps.context: Features should be easily discoverable from the hero section

steps.description: Check that memcached protocol compatibility is highlighted as a key feature
steps.context: This is a primary differentiator for MirDB

steps.description: Check that data persistence with SSTable format is explained
steps.context: Persistence is a key selling point vs standard memcached

steps.description: Check that LSM-tree architecture is mentioned with write-heavy workload benefits
steps.context: Technical users need to understand the underlying architecture

test_cases.input: Search page content for memcached-related text
test_cases.expected: Page contains text about 'Memcached Protocol Support' or 'memcached compatibility'

test_cases.input: Search page content for persistence-related text
test_cases.expected: Page contains text about 'Persistent Storage' and 'SSTable' format

test_cases.input: Search page content for LSM-tree text
test_cases.expected: Page contains text about 'LSM Tree Architecture' and 'compaction'

test_cases.input: Check features section has three distinct feature blocks
test_cases.expected: Three visually distinct feature cards/blocks are present highlighting key pillars

scenarios.name: Feature Highlights with Descriptions
scenarios.description: Verify that feature highlights are displayed with clear descriptions (REQ-3)

steps.description: Find the section containing detailed feature descriptions
steps.context: Features should have both titles and explanatory descriptions

steps.action: Verify each feature has a title
steps.description: Check that each feature highlight has a clear, descriptive title
steps.context: Titles should be scannable and informative

steps.action: Verify each feature has a description
steps.description: Check that each feature has accompanying descriptive text explaining the benefit
steps.context: Descriptions should help users understand the value

test_cases.input: Inspect feature card for memcached compatibility
test_cases.expected: Feature has title and description explaining drop-in compatibility with existing clients

test_cases.input: Inspect feature card for persistent storage
test_cases.expected: Feature has title and description explaining data survives restarts

test_cases.input: Inspect feature card for LSM architecture
test_cases.expected: Feature has title and description explaining efficient write-heavy workloads
Feature descriptions are at least 10 words each and explain benefits clearly

scenarios.name: Quick Start Section
scenarios.description: Verify that quick-start section provides basic usage examples (REQ-4)

steps.description: Locate the getting started or quick start section on the page
steps.context: Users need clear guidance on how to begin using MirDB

steps.description: Check that code snippets showing basic connection and operations are displayed
steps.context: Code examples should be copy-paste ready

steps.description: Check that default port (12333) and connection details are shown
steps.context: Users need to know how to connect to MirDB

test_cases.input: Check for quick start or getting started section
test_cases.expected: Page contains a clearly labeled 'Quick Start' or 'Getting Started' section
Section contains at least one code snippet showing basic usage
Code example demonstrates SET command usage
Code example demonstrates GET command usage
Default port 12333 is displayed in connection examples

scenarios.name: Supported Commands Display
scenarios.description: Verify that supported commands are listed on the page (REQ-5)

steps.description: Find the section listing supported memcached commands
steps.context: Users need to know what commands are available

steps.description: Check that storage commands (SET, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND) are listed
steps.context: These are the primary write operations

steps.description: Check that retrieval commands (GET, GETS) are listed
steps.context: These are the primary read operations

steps.description: Check that admin commands (INFO, MAJOR_COMPACTION, DELETE) are listed
steps.context: Admin commands are important for operations

test_cases.expected: SET command is listed in supported commands
GET command is listed in supported commands
DELETE command is listed in supported commands
ADD command is listed in supported commands
REPLACE command is listed in supported commands
A distinct section for commands reference is present on the page

scenarios.name: Configuration Parameters Display
scenarios.description: Verify that default configuration parameters are shown (REQ-6)

steps.description: Find the section displaying configuration parameters
steps.context: Users need to understand default configuration

steps.description: Check that important configuration parameters are displayed with their default values
steps.context: Parameters include listen address, LSM levels, memtable size, etc.

test_cases.expected: Default listen address (0.0.0.0:12333) is displayed
Max LSM levels (7) is mentioned in configuration
SSTable max size (100MB) is mentioned
Memtable max size (4MB) is mentioned
A configuration or parameters section is present on the page

steps.description: Verify focused elements have visible focus indicators

test_cases.expected: Body text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background
Heading text has at least 3:1 contrast ratio against background
All elements have alt attributes
All buttons and links can be reached via Tab key
Buttons show visible focus indicator when focused
Links show visible focus indicator when focused
